none: PAS CAM-6A6364: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 332- 333 (Reece period 17). VRBS ROMA. Reverse shows Wolf and Twins. Mint is Trier. See RIC VII p.217, no. 547. Obverse shows helmeted bust left. Obverse legend reads VRBS ROMA . Reverse fileds and exergue read: //TRS* Condition Very fine. Die axis 12 o'clock. Weight 2.22g, Diameter 17.44mm
